title: spinescope findings: one reader's structured spine MRI read
description: Structured findings for one spine MRI read by a human or an AI reader. Every field is {value, confidence, evidence, notes}. Missing key = not assessed. null value = indeterminate (looked, could not decide). Research use only; not a diagnosis.

reader.description: Reader name, e.g. ai_reader_a or radiologist_1. No patient identifiers.

scope.description: Which levels and sections were examined, and how.

levels.title: Disc levels
levels.description: Keys are disc labels such as L4-L5, T12-L1 or L5-S1.

notes.description: Anything that does not fit above.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: How sure the reader is of this field.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: One image the reader actually looked at.

image.description: PNG path (relative to the working directory, or absolute).

series.description: Stack key of the series, e.g. sag_t2, sag_stir, ax_t2, obl_ax_t2_4.

slices.description: Slice indices shown in the image; [] if the whole series.

EvidenceList.description: Every field needs at least one image.

pfirrmann.title: Pfirrmann grade
pfirrmann.description: 1 homogeneous bright T2 signal ... 5 inhomogeneous grey, collapsed disc.
